contract: Preserve initial diagnostics without an early return when init flag is zero. Select direction/start before null callback admission; null callback causes no lock or traversal.
Lock through live db+28, increment traversal budget with live sector size, preserve cached-sector copy, inclusion tests and one global started-search latch.
Binary search retains signed time/address comparisons, native32-byte midpoint rounding, exact-match bypass of the extra reverse probe, and reverse correction when a search misses.

Entries retain signed inclusive range tests, empty-status skipping, borrowed record/argument callback and early termination. Actual C next/last helpers retain their original conditional loads and unsigned arithmetic.
TSL read failure exits before decoding and reloads the live unlock callback at db+32. Record-address callback mutation affects the subsequent traversal.
intentional_C_changes: Define three local record buffers rather than exposing native private stack bytes. Seed sector+4 with the current address before a possibly non-writing sector read so error traversal has a defined cursor.
Preserve the preceding review error exits in ordinary C; no interior-entry labels or fixed register/frame behavior are promised.
limits: All392 main native instruction bytes execute in9903 normal-entry stock/C comparisons. Read/lock/user callbacks and diagnostics are modeled; real C traversal, memory copy and memory-clear bodies execute.

211 C-only error cases cover failure at every observed TSL read of four forward/reverse queries, different stack poison and non-writing sector failures. These are not asserted equivalent to stock ignored-error behavior.

13944 helper comparisons verify original traversal leaves. Callback results obey their declared C bool ABI; arbitrary invalid return encodings, corrupt pointers, callback lifetime abuse and private-stack aliasing are excluded.
